{{Otheruses|Rhen}}

'''Rhen''', a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] associated with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thannik]].<ref name="TRG">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

Rhen accompanied Thannik on a visit to the [[Dancing Dewback]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where Thannik intended to meet with a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] contact. The outlaw [[Dirk Harkness]], Thannik's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[GT-9R]], and a child named [[Cev Rees]] also accompanied the hunter. Rees caused Rhen some trouble when he picked the pocket of [[Fenn (spacer)|Fenn]], one of the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] at the bar. When Fenn noticed his wallet was missing, he found Rhen holding it as Rees melted into the crowd. Rhen claimed he had dropped it, and offered the burly spacer a drink in order to avoid any possible confrontation.<ref name="TRG" />

Rhen flew a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] named ''[[Thannik's Thunder]]''. She flew the freighter in combat against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] flying [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and against Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="TRG" />
